description: Parse messy address strings into structured components (street, city, state, ZIP, ZIP+4, country) using libpostal / Geoapify / Nominatim / regex.

inputs.description: DataFrame with one address per row in `address_column`

outputs.description: Same rows with addr_house_number / addr_road / addr_city / addr_state / addr_postcode / addr_postcode_plus4 / addr_country (prefix configurable)

upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset key (DataFrame). Mutually exclusive with `source` -- set exactly one.
upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key

source.label: Source
source.description: Pull rows directly via SQL instead of from an upstream asset: {kind: warehouse_query, resource_key: <registered resource> OR database_url_env_var: <env var>, sql: <query>}. Mutually exclusive with `upstream_asset_key` -- set exactly one.

address_column.description: Column containing the raw address string (one address per row).
address_column.label: Address Column

api_key_env_var.description: Env var for the provider's API key (geoapify). Ignored for libpostal / regex.
api_key_env_var.label: API Key Env Var (geoapify)

user_agent.description: User-Agent header sent to Nominatim. Must be unique per app per ToS.
user_agent.label: User-Agent (nominatim)

output_prefix.description: Prefix for emitted component columns (addr_house_number, addr_road, ...).
output_prefix.label: Output Column Prefix

keep_original.description: Keep the original address column in the output.
keep_original.label: Keep Original Address Column

rate_limit_seconds.description: Per-row delay for API-rate-limited providers (Nominatim defaults to 1.0).
rate_limit_seconds.label: Per-Row Rate Limit (seconds)

timeout_seconds.description: HTTP timeout per request for API providers.
timeout_seconds.label: HTTP Timeout (seconds)
